integrity: Explicit proof and executable diagnostics are provided. Novelty comparisons are literature-bounded; independent mathematical verification and comprehensive priority assessment are not claimed.
scientific_limitations: Finite real signals and positive edge weights, quadratic unit-vertex-mass Sobolev norm; graph-specific exact modulus requires optimization over cuts. General masses, nonlinearities, infinite graphs, and nonquadratic energies are not addressed.
title: Sharp weighted-degree bound and bipartite rigidity for graph-Sobolev truncation
